note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sends a weakened 2-model unit with OC 6 to obj_center, which the enemy holds with OC 23. The unit cannot flip it and is likely to be charged and destroyed. Fix: For a hold or move option on a contested objective, add the enemy OC already in range and the OC of enemy units that can reach it.
